verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a first-party capability that turns signals in product data into researched reports and proposed improvements, delivered to an in-product Inbox for review. Community hands-on use confirms an in-product LLM assistant exists, though one user hit functional limits (it could not create cohorts) and severe input lag. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how insights are generated and what they cover, independent corroboration of insight quality, and evidence that the in-product assistant performs reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Turn signals in your product data (errors, rage clicks, failed queries, and more) into researched reports and pull requests, delivered to your Inbox for you to review and merge.
Review proposed improvements and pull requests, then decide what ships.
